jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle.  Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics. What is your Day to Day Mission: Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers.  Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators.  System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses.  Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs. Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time. What you bring to the team: Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems.  Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement). System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques. Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation.  State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints.  Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments. Your Benefits:  Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.  Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.  Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.  Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget.  Health & Wellness:

This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale. manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us. manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up. It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
tags: inl - institut des nanotechnologies de lyon
jobs.description: Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit. The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible. The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability. A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning. Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects. Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research. Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations. Starting date: Fall 2026 Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? We are looking for multiple Software Engineer Interns to join some of Back Market’s Engineering teams in the Paris office. Depending on your interests and experience, you may contribute to projects across our product, platform, data, payments, shipping, customer experience or circularity teams. Our Engineering teams build the technology that powers Back Market, from customer-facing experiences to the internal services used by our teams and partners. You will work alongside software engineers, product managers, designers, data analysts and other stakeholders in a collaborative and international environment. With support from experienced engineers, you will learn how we design, develop, test, deploy and monitor reliable software in a production environment. What you will do in this role As a Software Engineer Intern, you will learn and contribute alongside experienced engineers: Assist with developing and improving features, with guidance from your team. Participate in writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code. Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions to learn from the team. Help investigate bugs and support the resolution of technical issues. Participate in testing, deployment and monitoring activities. Work with product, design, data and operations teams to understand requirements. Assist with maintaining technical documentation and sharing knowledge. Explore different technologies and gradually build your skills across the software development lifecycle. You will join an agile "build it and run it" environment, where teams take part in building, launching, monitoring and improving the products and services they own. Your level of responsibility will grow throughout the internship, with regular guidance and feedback from your team. OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT 💻 The technologies you use will depend on the team you join. Our engineering environment may include: Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Golang and Django Frontend: Vue.js, TypeScript, Nuxt and Revolve, our design system Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ and BigQuery Infrastructure and delivery: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Datadog, Argo CD, CircleCI and GitHub You do not need experience with all of these technologies. We are more interested in your technical foundations, curiosity and willingness to learn. YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ Mandatory! Currently enrolled in your final year of an Engineering School/University Master's degree and your university can provide an internship agreement - already based in France You have knowledge of basic coding languages and ideally Python and have basic programming experience (other internships, github, personal or student projects). You have knowledge of databases and operating systems You have the ability to learn new software and technologies quickly, being curious about the coding environment you’ll evolve in. You are detail-oriented and have the desire and ability to work in a team in an international environment. You are fluent in English - French is a plus. You are looking for a 6 month, full-time role (35h/week), internship from March/April 2026 You are authorized to work in France (EU Nationality or in possession of valid student visa/work permit). jobs.description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! Your impact Great growth experiences are built by great engineers. At Pennylane, Growth Engineering is about more than building landing pages or running experiments. It's about creating fast, reliable and seamless digital experiences that help entrepreneurs discover Pennylane and get started. As we expand across Europe, our website and acquisition journeys need to become more scalable, more flexible and more effective. We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong frontend expertise to help us build the next generation of Pennylane's digital experiences. You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead , within the Marketing Website squad. Your work will have a direct impact on how users discover, experience and adopt Pennylane. What you'll do Build great web experiences You'll develop and improve our public website and acquisition journeys, with a strong focus on frontend engineering. Build modern, responsive and high-performing interfaces using Vue.js and Nuxt.js. Develop and maintain fullstack features using Ruby on Rails. Improve website performance, accessibility and user experience. Build reusable components and scalable frontend solutions. Drive growth through engineering You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to turn business opportunities into technical solutions. Build and improve acquisition and registration funnels. Design and implement A/B tests and new user experiences. Improve conversion through technical experimentation. Develop features that support our international expansion, including localization and multilingual experiences. Connect systems and data You'll contribute to the technical foundations that power our growth initiatives. Build and maintain APIs and integrations between internal and external tools. Ensure reliable data flows across our digital ecosystem. Contribute to tracking implementations and data quality improvements. Work with Data teams to better understand user journeys and experiment results. Improve how we build You'll help us move fast without compromising engineering quality. Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code. Identify opportunities to simplify and automate workflows. Use AI-powered development tools when they bring real value. Take owners

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. ▪️ Le processus de recrutement  Échange RH : Aligneme

jobs.title: Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo RetailTech
jobs.description: L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.   Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.   La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business.    C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille.  Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager , ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client.   - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée , en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique , en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives).   Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning.   - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires . Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle , impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité.   Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits .   Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque

We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! The role: As a Forward Deployed Engineer intern in the PRO business unit, you will build the RevOps system (apps, API and MCP connectors, AI-ready data), embedded with the Sales and Marketing teams. You will: Design and build systems that remove friction from the way we sell. Make our data AI-ready and put it into the hands of tools, agents and sales reps. Consolidate our tools into one AI Sales Studio. You will work directly with our RevOps PRO, who guarantees the vision, the strategy and the RevOps system as a whole. He will coach you day to day: architecture choices, review of what you ship, and priorities. The goal is for you to own your scope quickly. This is a 6-month internship (an internship agreement with your school is required)!   Your Impact at Brevo: AI-ready data: Standardise data ingestion with a guaranteed format designed for AI. Make that data available in our apps and tools, so AEs can use it easily. AI Sales Studio: Merge our existing custom apps into one tool and extend it with new features. One tool to rule them all. Connectors: Connect our tools through APIs and MCP (CRM, Chili Piper, Gong, Clay, Chargebee…) to remove re-keying and waiting between teams. Autonomous demand generation: Wire the lead scoring specified by the RevOps Analyst into our tools. Bring AEs new signals (intent, firmographics) and new sources, with prospecting tooling they use on their own. Lean system: Remove dead automations and duplicates, and put monitoring on what runs. What will contribute to your success: Experience and education: Engineering school, business school or an atypical path. Your building track record matters more than your degree. Side projects, a deployed app or an MCP server you built are a strong plus. System & AI skills: You understand at an advanced level how a system is built: functions, APIs, MCP, CI, deployment, data. No need to code by hand: you know how to architect and get it built with AI. You have already shipped apps, agents or integrations with Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent. Beyond the technical: Product mindset: you start from a business problem, not a technology, and ship small and fast. Business curiosity: you want to understand how we sell. jobs.title: Responsable Comptable Général (H/F/X)
jobs.description: Biggie est un groupe de conseil en communication, né de la fusion de l’agence média Repeat , du trading desk Gamned! , du studio de création vidéo Kazam et de l’agence en stratégie d’influence Beastly .   Comprenant 300 collaborateurs et des filiales dans de nombreux pays (France, Belgique, Suisse, Italie, République Tchèque, Emirats Arabes Unis, Brésil…), le groupe s’appuie sur sa capacité à fédérer l’excellence, via l’intégration d’expertises publicitaires leader de leur marché, de manière à concevoir et piloter des stratégies de communication 360 à l'échelle l’internationale. En tant que Responsable Comptable Général, vous êtes garant(e) de l’ensemble des opérations comptables et financières. Vous supervisez la production des états financiers dans le respect des normes comptables en vigueur et assurez la qualité et la fiabilité des informations financières à destination des parties prenantes internes et externes.   Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec tous les services de la Finance (Comptabilité Clients, Comptabilité Fournisseurs, l’ADV et le contrôle de gestion), le obligations comptables et fiscales :  • Garantir la bonne tenue des écritures comptables dans le respect des normes françaises (et éventuellement internationales type IFRS si applicable). • Echange continu et régulier avec la comptabilité fournisseurs et la comptabilité clients • Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales (TVA, IS, CVAE, CFE, DAS2, etc.) • Être le(la) référent(e) en matière de veille fiscale et garantir la conformité des pratiques aux obligations légales en vigueur.   2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (mensuelle, trimestrielle, annuelle) et Audit des comptes:  • Etablir les clôtures complètes, analyse détaillée et formalisation des comptes et des provisions • Préparer les reportings périodiques financiers et comptables destinés à la Direction Financière et à la Direction Générale • Etablir les états financiers et les annexes aux comptes annuels • Assurer l’audit des comptes en étant le point de contact principal.   3- Management d’équipe :  • Encadrer et animer une équipe comptable (recrutement, formation, montée en compétences des collaborateurs) • Veiller à l'organisation et à la répartition des tâches au sein de l'équipe au quotidien et en période de clôture pour garantir le respect des deadlines   4- Projets transverses : • Participer à la mise en place et/ou à l’amélioration des outils comptables et des processus internes • Accompagner les projets de transformation liés à la digitalisation des fonctions financières   👉 Profil recherché   Formation et expérience : • Issu(e) d’une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance (DSCG, Master CCA, École de Commerce ou équivalent) • Expérience confirmée (5 à 8 ans minimum) en comptabilité générale, idéalement dans un environnement multi-sites/multi-sociétés ou en cabinet d'expertise comptable/audit avant un poste en entreprise • Une expérience dans le secteur des médias ou une familiarité avec les spécificités liées au secteur serait un plus   Compétences techniques : • Maîtrise des normes comptables françaises et idéalement IFRS • Excellente connaissance des logiciels comptables et ERP (exemples : SAP, Sage, Oracle, etc.) • Maîtrise avancée d’Excel • Bonne compréhension des outils de dématérialisation et des processus de digitalisation comptable • Bon niveau dans la pratique de l’anglais (écrit et oral)   Qualités personnelles : • Rigoureux(se), Organisé(e), Structuré(e) et Polyvalent(e) • Leader d’équipe ayant d’excellentes capacités managériales • Sens de la communication et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés • Sensibilité aux délais et esprit de priorisation. &nbsp

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis. Responsibilities Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds. Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production. Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times. Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early. Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations. Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers. Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria. Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering. Requirements You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units. You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection. You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts. You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline. You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers. You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar. You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
jobs.description: Über VIA HealthTech VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat. Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat. Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf. Die Rolle Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus. In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht. Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem. Deine Aufgaben Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen. Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen. Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt. Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert. Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut. Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF. Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam. Dein Profil Must-have Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Syste

If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them. What you'll own You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means: Training and fine-tuning : embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data. Document understanding : models that pull structure, quantities and product specs out of tenders, orders and catalogs. Product matching : retrieval and LLM agents that match tender positions to the right products. Evaluation : offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse. jobs.description: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere  Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank. We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done. Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  Work from anywhere! Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.  Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate . Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical) Standards and regulatory scope The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Required qualifications Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine) Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard Solid know

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The Role As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data. You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs. This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver. You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different. What Excites You Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions. Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions. Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges. Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work. Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility. Responsibilities Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges. Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements. Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios. Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions. Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made. jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release; Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing; Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features. What you bring A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer; Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans; Experience with test automation and test frameworks; You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests; Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira. You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not; You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business. Nice to have Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code; You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support. Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests; You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better; Experience testing mobile apps. We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it , Say it , Make it . jobs.title: Head of Compliance
jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week

jobs.title: Model Risk Officer
jobs.description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own ter

jobs.title: HR Consultant
jobs.description: De functie Als HR Consultant zorg je ervoor dat de dagelijkse HR-processen binnen Interconnect soepel en zorgvuldig verlopen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte personeelsadministratie, bewaakt de kwaliteit van HR-processen en ondersteunt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je werkt aan verschillende onderdelen van de employee journey, waaronder in-, door- en uitstroom, verzuimadministratie, personeelsmutaties en werving & selectie. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over het verbeteren van processen en het verder professionaliseren van de HR-dienstverlening. Je maakt deel uit van een betrokken HR-team, bestaande uit een HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner en HR-medewerker. Het team valt onder de afdeling Business Support. Wat ga je doen? Beheren en bewaken van de kwaliteit en volledigheid van personeelsdossiers. Verwerken en controleren van personeelsgegevens in HR-systemen, waaronder Nmbrs. Ondersteunen bij de salarisverwerking en uitvoeren van administratieve controles. Adviseren over personeelsregelingen, arbeidsvoorwaarden en HR-procedures. Beantwoorden van HR-gerelateerde vragen van leidinggevenden en medewerkers. Verzorgen van administratieve processen rondom in-, door- en uitstroom en verzuim. Bijdragen aan HR-projecten en de realisatie van HR-doelstellingen. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en optimaliseren van HR-processen en werkwijzen. Wie ben jij? Je houdt van structuur, werkt zorgvuldig en vindt het leuk om collega's verder te helpen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en denk je actief mee over hoe zaken slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden georganiseerd. Je beschikt over: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding. Kennis van HR-processen, personeelsadministratie en relevante wet- en regelgeving. Bij voorkeur enkele jaren werkervaring als HR-medewerker, HR Consultant of in een vergelijkbare functie. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling. Een proactieve, nauwkeurige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding. Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week. Ervaring met Nmbrs is een mooie aanvulling. Wat biedt Interconnect? Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een prettige werksfeer centraal staan. Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een bruto maandsalaris tot € 4.250 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en opleidingsniveau. Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus die kan oplopen tot één bruto maandsalaris. Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Een goede pensioenregeling waarbij Interconnect gemiddeld twee derde van de premie betaalt. 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 extra dagen bij te kopen. Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,21 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van het openbaar vervoer. Mogelijkheid om maximaal 40% van de contracturen vanuit huis te werken. Een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan en mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op: Een moderne werkomgeving in het hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, inclusief lunch-/werkcafé, gaming room en skybar. jobs.description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. WHO YOU ARE You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts. You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else. You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it. THE OPPORTUNITY Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend. The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the commercial model Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation. Drive the rollout across the ecosystem With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. jobs.description: About impact.com impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results. Your Role at impact.com: Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight. As Marketing Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on. What You'll Do: Own the process for the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews that marketing and sales leaders use to track campaign performance and business trends — and improve them over time so they drive decisions rather than descriptions. Translate vague business questions ("why is pipeline soft in EMEA?") into workable analyses, sell a solution, and manage the delivery process efficiently. Partner with internal customers and engineers to move recurring manual reporting into useful tools that drive decisions which save time and money. Work directly with stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, product, and customer success to scope what they actually need and design a plan to get them that information efficiently and with the right level of accuracy. Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model. What You Bring: 5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business. A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python — enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help. A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting. Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action. Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things. Nice to Have: Experience with attribution modeling — multi-touch, time decay, incrementality Experience with lead scoring Experience with integration of sales and marketing data and a full-funnel perspective Experience with dbt, databricks, Looker, or another data management tool Experience in partnership marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000 per year, plus an additional 5% vari

jobs.title: 3D & LiDAR Data Annotation Analyst
jobs.description: About the Role We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments. As a Data Annotation Analyst, you’ll work with camera imagery, video, and LiDAR point clouds to create precise labels that help perception systems understand objects, people, terrain, and surrounding environments. You’ll work in specialized annotation tools, following detailed specifications while balancing accuracy, consistency, and production volume. Your Impact Annotate 2D and 3D objects across images, video, and LiDAR point clouds, including vehicles, machinery, people, signage, and environmental features. Create and maintain accurate segmentation, object tracking, pose, and keypoint annotations across sequences. Apply detailed annotation guidelines, including class definitions, occlusion rules, object thresholds, and inclusion/exclusion criteria. Review your work, respond to QA feedback, and maintain established quality and accuracy standards. Identify and escalate ambiguous scenes, sensor artifacts, tooling issues, and gaps in specifications rather than making assumptions. Document data quality and tooling issues with clear details and reproduction steps. Participate in calibration sessions, guideline reviews, and team standups to maintain consistent interpretations. Share observations that help improve annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and edge-case documentation. Success in this role means producing accurate, consistent annotations at the expected volume while helping maintain a reliable, high-quality dataset. What You Bring Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, visually intensive work for extended periods. Strong spatial reasoning skills, including the ability to interpret 3D environments and understand object size, position, and orientation. Ability to learn and navigate complex, purpose-built software and become productive with keyboard shortcuts and other tooling features. Experience working in a fast-paced, scaled environment with defined productivity, quality, or accuracy targets. Experience with image annotation GenAI workflows Reliable high-speed internet, a distraction-free workspace, and the ability to work on a company-provisioned machine within a controlled environment. Nice to Haves Associate or bachelor’s degree. Experience with image, video, LiDAR, or 3D annotation tools. Experience with subsurface utility engineering (SUE), construction surveying, surveying, GIS, or other work involving spatial interpretation of physical environments. Experience with AutoCAD or similar type tools Experience in construction, mining, agriculture, industrial operations, or heavy equipment environments. Familiarity with point cloud data, sensor fusion, or camera-LiDAR calibration. Experience working with autonomous vehicles, robotics, or machine perception datasets. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest-quality AI solutions for frontier models. You’ll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You’ll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. jobs.description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role: In Token Factory analytics there is no split into product analysts, ML engineers and data engineers. jobs.description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. Our Growth and Marketing Analytics team ⭐ We’re looking for a Data Director to join our Growth and Marketing Collective here at Monzo. Our goal in Growth and Marketing is to build Monzo into a global brand people love. We're the team that finds exciting new ways to bring customers to Monzo and keep them engaged once they join.
